notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes: Vertical platform should not get the player stuck if the goblin is directly underneath in certain conditions anymore.

notes.title: More minor changes due to feedback
notes.notes:
Additional changes due to recent feedback:

 Mushrooms in dark mines should now act as slopes
 HUD now properly shows 2 lives in underground if you interact with the ghost chest

notes.title: Small changes based on the initial feedback
notes.notes:
I've changed some things based on the initial feedback in the playtest hub. Let's hope these are for the better. Please continue writing your thoughts and opinions down. 


 Added  and  to map navigation alongside left/right. 
 Added a slight shadow to roofs and mushrooms where you can walk.
 Moved "look around" hint in the Dark mines level from the beginning to the area where the secret coins are hidden. 
 Worked on the crusher skull in the underground, needs more testing.
